description: This file defines the ConverterLoader interface, which is used to load Java object converters within the Apache OFBiz framework. It declares a method for creating and registering converters with the conversion framework.

classes.name: ConverterLoader
classes.description: Interface for loading Java object converters in the OFBiz conversion framework.

methods.description: Method to create and register converters within the framework.
